categories.main_business_segments: Yuanjie Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, production, and sales of optical chips. Its main products include DFB and EML laser series chips with transmission rates ranging from 2.5G to 200G and higher, as well as high-power silicon photonic light source products. These products are mainly applied in fiber optic access, 4G/5G mobile communication networks, data centers, and automotive LiDAR markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturing) model covering chip design, wafer manufacturing, chip processing, and testing. Core technologies include buried heterostructure and ridge waveguide laser chip manufacturing platforms, high-speed modulation laser chip technology, heterojunction compound semiconductor material bonding growth, small divergence angle technology, anti-reflection technology, electro-absorption modulator integration, integrated optical chip high reliability technology, and high-power laser chip reliability technology. Production involves MOCVD epitaxial growth, photolithography, etching, thin film deposition, and automated chip testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the telecommunications sector (fiber optic access and mobile communication networks) and data center operators, especially those deploying AI infrastructure requiring high-speed optical modules. The company also serves automotive LiDAR manufacturers. The telecom market remains the dominant revenue source, with growing contributions from data center markets driven by AI compute demand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Shaanxi Province. It also has subsidiaries in Singapore and the United States, serving both domestic and international customers. Overseas sales and assets are a small portion of total operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuanjie Semiconductor operates upstream in the optical communication supply chain as a manufacturer of core optical chips. It controls the full production process from chip design, wafer epitaxy, chip fabrication, to testing and packaging, enabling autonomous and integrated manufacturing capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment focusing on high-speed laser chips, high-power optical chips, and chip process technologies. It is developing next-generation 25G/50G PON products, high-power CW laser chips for silicon photonics, and advanced EML chips for 100G/200G applications. Strategic priorities include expanding into AI data center markets, automotive LiDAR, and exploring new application scenarios. The company also focuses on talent development and building a strong innovation platform.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical chips and, to a lesser extent, packaged laser modules. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with contracts specifying quality acceptance and revenue recognition upon customer confirmation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuanjie Semiconductor is positioned as a leading domestic optical chip supplier in China, transitioning from a telecom-focused supplier to a dual-driven supplier covering telecom and data communication markets. It competes with international suppliers in high-speed and high-power optical chips, particularly in data center applications. The company leverages proprietary technologies to differentiate from competitors and reduce reliance on imported components.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 252 million, a 74.63% increase year-over-year, driven by recovering downstream demand and expansion into data center markets. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 6.13 million, reflecting increased R&D investment and pricing pressures. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.15 billion and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, indicating a growth trajectory with ongoing profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuanjie Semiconductor emphasizes its IDM integrated manufacturing capability, proprietary core technologies such as small divergence angle and anti-reflection laser chips, and high reliability under harsh conditions. Its products offer differentiated performance with high power, low cost, and compatibility with emerging silicon photonics and AI data center demands. The company also highlights its comprehensive product portfolio across multiple application scenarios and strong customer validation as key competitive advantages.
